heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated not to exceed $12,000,000 to carry out land acquisition and development as authorized in this subchapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2017—Pub. L. 115–31 inserted “land acquisition and development as authorized in” after “carry out”.
